definitions.started_in_game_injury: Fantasy starter whose verified in-game injury caused missed snaps and prevented normal completion of the NFL game. Full return and normal finish excluded.
definitions.rotation_injury: Started >=2 of prior 4 completed fantasy weeks for this manager; verified injury-limited game ending counts even if benched that week.
definitions.major_rotation_injury: Qualifying rotation injury with >=4 subsequent NFL games missed, injured reserve or season-ending absence, supported by evidence.
definitions.non_additive: A single injury may qualify for multiple categories; do not sum category totals.
